prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape 2:1 illustration used as the TOP SHOP BANNER of a fantasy mobile game. Reference is STYLE ONLY. Clean 2D comic cel-shaded medieval quartermaster's shop interior, crisp dark-brown lines, few large deliberate painted color planes, chunky simplified forms. Warm oak counter foreground, an inviting red-and-ivory striped small canopy, sunlit arch window with sky at the upper-right, one shelf with a chest and neatly arranged potions, one rack of just three weapons at the right. A shield and rolled map on the counter at right. Leave the entire LEFT 40% quietly lit warm wood and a broad dark plank sign without text, for code-rendered shop title; top 25% calm darker beam shadows for overlay currency HUD. Strong composition with right-side merchandise and architectural depth, no character required. Golden ambient daylight, clear warm light and cool slate shadow planes. Less ornament, more readable story. Wide header scene with all major contents visible in mobile 750x380 crop. NO characters, no UI controls, no letters, no numbers, no ornate jewels, no realistic grain, no complicated racks, no orange mist, no photorealistic 3D rendering, no depth-of-field blur, no volumetric god rays, no busy micro-details. A polished hand-drawn game environment coherent with the reference.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION illustration for an actual 2D fantasy tower-defense game. Reference image is STYLE ONLY; do not reproduce its board, text or UI arrangement. Match its clean COMIC CEL-SHADED art. Crisp dark charcoal/espresso contours, consistent line-weight, chunky heroic fantasy shapes, restrained 2 or 3 hard-edged values per material, a few broad highlights from upper left. Metal has painted flat planes; wood has only 2 or 3 deliberate grain lines; gems have few large facets. Strong clear silhouette readable at 48px. Palette golden amber, forest green, cyan, indigo, warm ivory. Precisely designed solid shapes with deliberate craftsmanship, not generic polished AI illustration. No soft airbrush, photoreal texture, shiny plastic, ornamental gold filigree, tiny engraving, bloom, stars, random floating particles, text, logos, watermarks, UI frames or board. SINGLE isolated inventory object centered on genuine TRANSPARENT background, filling about 80% of square canvas with even clear margins. Fully visible, no clipped edges. Slight three-quarter view. No ground, landscape, base, pedestals or cast shadow outside the object. Broad dark outline and only simple painted interior shading. It is a small game icon, NOT product photography. SUBJECT: one thick gold coin, slightly angled, with a simple large embossed three-point crown, golden yellow face, amber shadow plane, ivory edge highlight. Uncomplicated readable circular silhouette.
